products.description: Our standard 50g package. Contains premium green tea infused with organic tulsi leaves, lemongrass, and dry ginger. Blended with care for a fresh, balanced flavor to complement your daily tea ritual.
products.short_description: 100% natural handcrafted herbal green tea infused with Tulsi, Lemongrass, and Ginger.
brewing_instructions: Heat fresh water to approx. 85°C (bubbles forming, not boiling).
Add 1 teaspoon (approx 2g) of tea blend into your infuser cup.
Pour water and steep covered for 3 to 5 minutes.
Inhale the steam, strain, and sip mindfully.

reviews.comment: Absolutely love this blend! The flavor of lemongrass and ginger is extremely balanced. I drink it every evening as part of my routine.
This is very different from standard commercial green teas. You can see real ginger particles and whole leaves. Highly recommended combo pack!
Very nice aroma. Good packaging, though I wish there was a zipper seal on the pouch.
